Subject: Intermittent loss of therapy
summary: Patient reported therapy dropping out when bending forward. Lead fracture confirmed at explant, at the electrode-lead junction.

Subject: Shock sensation on posture change
summary: Patient felt a brief shock when sitting up. Sense lead impedance out of range; fracture at the junction found on X-ray.

Subject: Charger does not start
summary: Charger LED stays off. Replaced under warranty; no fault found on return.

Subject: Stimulation too strong, then stopped
summary: Patient reported painful stimulation for about two seconds, then none. Logs show the control loop raising amplitude to the ceiling, as [[REQ-0002]] requires it to stop.

Subject: Skin irritation at the charging site
summary: Redness under the charging coil after long sessions. Advised shorter sessions.

Subject: Therapy lost after a fall
summary: Signal lost after the patient fell. Lead revised; fracture at the junction.

Subject: Programmer app crashes on login
summary: App closed on login on one tablet model. Fixed in app 2.1.4.

Subject: Battery drains in a day
summary: Recharge needed daily instead of weekly. Therapy settings were at the top of the range; no fault found.

Subject: Lead migration suspected
summary: Paresthesia moved from the leg to the hip. Reprogrammed; no revision.

Subject: Signal loss when bending
summary: Intermittent "signal lost" alerts when bending, for a week. Lead fracture at the junction, confirmed at revision.

Subject: Charger cable frayed
summary: Cable insulation split at the strain relief. Charger replaced.

Subject: Unexpected stimulation increase
summary: Patient reported stronger stimulation for a few minutes. Investigation open.
